source_note: Original AI-assisted community practice path spanning entry, mid, and senior individual-contributor tasks. Each pinned round is a separate practice attempt, not a hiring sequence. Practitioner review and scoring calibration are pending; these exercises do not certify professional or operational competence.
name: Dentistry Practice
blurb: Practice consent support, referral verification, and an appointment-access evidence review.

rounds.title: Dental Assistant: Support a Patient Who Wants to Pause
rounds.focus: Respect a pause, surface an unanswered question, and support an informed conversation with the clinician.

rounds.title: Dental Clinician: Repair an Unconfirmed Referral Handoff
rounds.focus: Distinguish transmission from acceptance and repair an overconfident referral message.

rounds.title: Senior Dental Clinician: Review an Appointment Access Claim
rounds.focus: Challenge a misleading attendance claim and evaluate reminders without excluding people who need another channel.
